    Cohort expression workflow (overview)

    Chen Zhan

    2026-09-09

    cohort-expression-workflow.Rmd

    SAVI case study (ADRB2 / ENSG00000169252 in disease-associated monocytes).

    posteriorHCA provides transparent statistical core functions and a small set of convenience wrappers built directly on those cores.

    Path Focus Vignette
    Concise wrapper workflow ~ 0 + Category group means vignette("cohort-expression-wrappers")
    Transparent core workflow optional edgeR formula + contrast helper vignette("cohort-expression-core")

    Matching script: examples/savi_adrb2_workflow.R (core path).

    High-level API 

    scale_to_hca_reference()
estimate_cohort_logmu()
expression_baseline_draws()
compare_cohort_to_hca()

    Core API 

    load_reference_sample()
merge_with_reference_sample()
calculate_tmm_scaling()

estimate_ql()

load_expression_fit()
build_newdata_grid()
expression_draws()

summarize_posterior_draws()
welch_test_means()

    Wrappers reduce boilerplate. Cores expose the methodology. They must not diverge statistically.
